business_reporting_question: Calculate total orders and discounted order count per tier
flawed_ai_sql_pattern: SELECT tier, COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(*) as discounted FROM ... WHERE discount IS NOT NULL
defect_classification: Flawed WHERE scope cuts base count
ansi_compliant_validated_sql: SELECT tier, COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(discount) as discounted FROM ...
discrepancy_explanation: Filtering in WHERE eliminates non-discounted rows before COUNT(*) can tally overall order volume.

business_reporting_question: List customers with over $1000 in completed sales
flawed_ai_sql_pattern: SELECT customer, SUM(subtotal) FROM ... WHERE SUM(subtotal) > 1000 GROUP BY customer
ansi_compliant_validated_sql: SELECT customer, SUM(subtotal) FROM ... GROUP BY customer HAVING SUM(subtotal) > 1000
discrepancy_explanation: Aggregates cannot appear in WHERE clause; must filter aggregated groups using HAVING.

business_reporting_question: Filter US orders before aggregating revenue over $500
flawed_ai_sql_pattern: SELECT country, SUM(subtotal) FROM ... GROUP BY country HAVING country = 'USA' AND SUM(subtotal) > 500
ansi_compliant_validated_sql: SELECT country, SUM(subtotal) FROM ... WHERE country = 'USA' GROUP BY country HAVING SUM(subtotal) > 500
discrepancy_explanation: Placing row filters in HAVING forces database to group all world records before filtering, destroying index usage.

business_reporting_question: Calculate average discount percentage across orders
discrepancy_explanation: In many SQL engines integer division truncates to zero, and NULL discounts cause entire average calculation to omit rows.

business_reporting_question: Monthly revenue grouped across midnight boundaries
flawed_ai_sql_pattern: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date), SUM(subtotal) FROM orders GROUP BY 1
ansi_compliant_validated_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', datetime(order_date, 'localtime')), SUM(subtotal) FROM orders ...
discrepancy_explanation: An order placed at 23:55 UTC flips into the following month in local business timezones, distorting financial monthly closes.
